jobs.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) builds and operates cloud services that help customers solve some of their largest technical and business challenges. Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), OCI’s managed Kubernetes service, enables customers to deploy, run, scale, and secure Kubernetes workloads with integrated compute, networking, storage, identity, and observability.

We are seeking a Director of Platform Software Engineering to lead teams responsible for core OKE platform capabilities. In this role, you will manage and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, set technical direction, and own delivery and operational outcomes for critical components of a highly available, globally distributed, 24x7 cloud service.

Your organization will advance Kubernetes cluster lifecycle management, orchestration, control plane reliability, scalability, performance, security, automation, and integration with OCI infrastructure. You will help evolve OKE to support larger clusters, more demanding enterprise workloads, and emerging AI and accelerated computing use cases.

This role requires deep Kubernetes knowledge, cloud infrastructure experience, strong distributed systems fundamentals, and a demonstrated ability to deliver through multiple engineering teams. You should be comfortable examining architecture and production behavior in detail, challenging technical assumptions, and guiding difficult decisions while empowering managers and engineers to own execution.

As a leader within OKE, you will partner with product management, senior architects, operations, and other OCI service teams to translate customer needs into a clear strategy and an achievable roadmap. Success requires sound judgment under ambiguity, disciplined execution, strong communication, and a commitment to developing people and improving the customer experience.

You will also guide the adoption of responsible AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices across design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operations. We expect you to help teams improve productivity while maintaining clear accountability for correctness, security, and production quality.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Lead, hire, coach, and develop engineering managers and software engineers. Build leadership capacity, establish clear expectations, and create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and technical excellence.
Define and execute the technical strategy and roadmap for core OKE platform capabilities, balancing customer needs, feature delivery, reliability, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
Own delivery across multiple teams, including prioritization, staffing, dependencies, milestones, and risk management. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear plans and measurable outcomes.
Guide architecture and design for distributed systems that create, update, scale, repair, and operate Kubernetes clusters across OCI regions.
Provide technical leadership across Kubernetes control planes, controllers and operators, APIs, etcd, scheduling, autoscaling, container runtimes, and cluster and node lifecycle management.
Partner with OCI compute, networking, storage, identity, and security teams to deliver reliable integrations and resolve issues across service and organizational boundaries.
Own service health and operational outcomes for your organization’s components of OKE, including availability, capacity, performance, operational readiness, and customer escalations.
Lead effective incident response and ensure corrective actions address underlying causes and prevent recurring failures.
Establish rigorous standards for design reviews, testing, observability, production readiness, safe deployments, canary validation, upgrades, and rollback.
Drive automation that improves fleet health, detects failures earlier, accelerates diagnosis and recovery, and reduces manual operations.
Partner with product management and customers to understand workload requirements and use customer feedback and production data to guide investment decisions.
Prepare the platform for demanding AI/ML and GPU workloads, working across teams on scalability, orchestration, resource management, and infrastructure integration.
Introduce and scale responsible AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows, measuring improvements in productivity and quality while maintaining security and human accountability.
Communicate strategy, delivery progress, service health, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering teams, partners, and senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience designing, building, and operating production software, including cloud infrastructure or distributed platform services.
Demonstrated success leading multiple engineering teams, managing engineering managers, developing technical leaders, and delivering complex initiatives across organizational boundaries.
Deep Kubernetes expertise and practical understanding of control plane architecture, cluster lifecycle, networking, storage, scalability, and production failure modes.
Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including availability, consistency, fault tolerance, performance, and operational tradeoffs.
Hands-on cloud infrastructure experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, GCP, or a comparable large-scale environment.
Strong software development background and the ability to guide design and implementation in Go and Java, supported by practical Linux, networking, and debugging knowledge.
Experience owning production service operations, incident response, safe change management, and sustained reliability improvements.
Strong judgment, communication, and execution skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity and organizational change.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building managed Kubernetes services or operating Kubernetes infrastructure at substantial scale.
Experience with Kubernetes networking and storage integrations, including CNI, CSI, Cilium, Calico, or equivalent technologies.
Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU clusters, distributed training or inference, GPU scheduling, device plugins, or high-performance networking.
Experience improving engineering productivity through automation and responsible AI-assisted or agentic workflows.
Contributions to Kubernetes or related cloud native open-source projects.

Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking a Director, Software Development to lead the technical direction and execution of foundational OCI security and trust services. This leader will guide engineering teams responsible for identity, authentication, authorization, service-to-service trust, KMS, secrets, KES, PKI, certificates, automation, monitoring, control-plane technologies, operational tooling, and cloud service efficiency.

The role combines technical leadership, team development, operational excellence, and cross-functional partnership for services that support OCI’s global cloud footprint and the internal and customer-facing products that depend on them.

Why OCI

OCI is building secure, scalable cloud infrastructure for customers that depend on trust, resilience, and operational rigor at global scale. This role offers the opportunity to shape core security and trust foundations, influence engineering practices across OCI, and lead a high-performing organization responsible for services at the heart of customer confidence and cloud reliability.

Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams. Accountable for group results and governance adherence; makes operational decisions ensuring compatibility, security, and performance. Sponsors cross-group innovation in resilience, capacity modeling, and interoperability. Communicates with executive leadership on platform health, risk, and adoption.

Team Responsibilities

Lead and grow engineering teams supporting OCI security and trust services.
Define and execute technical roadmaps for identity, authentication, authorization, service-to-service trust, KMS, secrets, KES, PKI, and certificates.
Drive the development of monitoring platforms, automation frameworks, control planes, and operational tooling.
Partner with OCI, Security, Architecture, and Product organizations to align priorities, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
Improve operational efficiency through automation, observability, engineering excellence, and cloud service efficiency initiatives.
Develop engineering managers and technical talent across the organization.
Lead organizational planning, resource allocation, hiring, and team growth.

Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.

Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions.

Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes.
Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.

An Overview Of This Role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.

What You’ll Do

Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.

Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.

Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.

Define meaningful reliability measures and operating reviews that expose systemic risk, guide investment decisions, and demonstrate progress without incentivizing superficial compliance.
Create a healthy on-call system with the staffing, tooling, training, and management support required to sustain reliable services without normalizing burnout or heroics.
Establish reliability practices for AI-enabled systems, including appropriate observability, evaluation, degradation, and fallback mechanisms for non-deterministic production behavior.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. NVIDIA’s advanced datacenter boards push forward chip packaging, PCB fabrication, SMT, assembly, and testing capabilities. Dedicated teams take responsibility for each technology: packaging manages the package, PCB and materials handle fabrication and stack-up, SMT and assembly oversee build processes, and test and SI focus on test capabilities. The challenge is to align these improvements across the stack—from chip to PCB, PCB to SMT, SMT to assembly, and assembly to test. Each domain’s innovation delivers maximum benefit when downstream consequences are considered early. The Senior Director, Board PDE oversees integration methods that make this possible—coordinating handoffs, engineering cross-domain effects before changes, and optimizing the entire chain.

What You'll Be Doing

Design, implement, and institutionalize the integration readiness process for all next-generation datacenter board products — owning manufacturing and test readiness end to end so build starts land on schedule and at target yield.
Guide the functional teams in developing cross-boundary techniques before silicon and stackup freeze occurs. Focus on warpage-tolerant DFM and reflow for next-gen BGA pitch. Manage impedance and CTE control for high-speed stackups. Lock pad-map and fab methods at an early stage.
Build, lead, and develop a global Board PDE organization across three technical pillars — PCB & Fab, SMT/PCBA, and High-Speed Connector & Signal Integrity.
Set up integration oversight throughout the chip-to-board stack. Define entry and exit requirements at each domain boundary. Lead the gates to confirm one qualified domain is ready to pass to the next.
Collaborate with Operations Test Engineering and Signal Integrity to establish test coverage and manufacturing test flow requirements, applying that thoroughness to the tester and diagnostic boards.
Take charge of reliability and yield performance throughout the stack. Investigate excursions to identify root causes. Address DFx and alternate-component gaps with the factory planning and design teams.
Support manufacturing partners (CM/ODM/OSAT, substrate, and PCB fab) in producing world-class datacenter products. Serve as the senior chip-to-board representative across NVIDIA's Operations, Engineering, and Executive teams.

Experience building or scaling an SRE organization in a hyper growth environment while improving both service health and engineering velocity.

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on, strategically minded, and execution-focused Director of Data Platform & Migration Engineering to lead our Hospitality data engineering function and support one of the company's most important strategic initiatives: the bulk migration of customers from On-Prem Property Management Systems (PMS) to our Cloud PMS platform.

This role will own the strategy and execution across data migrations, database architecture and health, performance engineering, and reporting data enablement. You will lead a team of 3-5 data engineers responsible for building scalable migration capabilities, strengthening our data platforms, and creating reliable foundations for reporting and downstream data solutions.

The successful candidate will bring broad, practical AWS experience beyond managed database services. They should be comfortable operating within a cloud-native ecosystem and partnering on architecture, security, networking, observability, reliability, automation, and cost-aware design. They will work closely with application engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and Operations because many database and migration improvements require coordinated changes across the wider platform.

This is an equal part strategic and hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys solving complex data problems, improving operational efficiency, and applying AI where it produces measurable value in migrations, reporting, or data engineering.

What You Will Do

Own the strategy and roadmap for Hospitality data platforms, ensuring scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and cost-effective solutions within the broader AWS environment.

Lead the strategy and execution for bulk migrations from On-Prem PMS solutions to Cloud PMS, including planning, tooling, automation, orchestration, transformation, validation, reconciliation, rollback, and operational readiness.
Own the data engineering strategy for reporting and define governed, scalable ways to provide reliable data to solution partners for reports, analytics, and other data solutions.
Own the architecture, health, performance, scalability, resilience, and lifecycle of databases supporting Hospitality products, primarily Cloud PMS.
Set database engineering standards for data modelling, schema design, indexing, query patterns, change management, capacity planning, backup and recovery, and production readiness.
Lead performance tuning and platform enhancements across Amazon Aurora MySQL on Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and related technologies.
Partner with application engineering teams to deliver application-level changes that improve database efficiency, data quality, reliability, and scalability.
Establish AWS platform guardrails, observability, operational metrics, automation, disaster-recovery practices, and service ownership for data-intensive systems.
Apply AI in practical, responsible ways to reduce manual effort and improve quality across migrations, reporting, and data engineering, including mapping, transformation, anomaly detection, reconciliation, risk identification, and documentation.
Ensure AI initiatives move beyond experimentation by defining measurable outcomes, validation, security controls, human oversight, and clear operational ownership.
Lead, coach, and grow data engineering team, building a culture of ownership, technical excellence, learning, pragmatic decision-making, and continuous improvement.
Translate ambiguous business needs into a prioritized roadmap and executable plans, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Security, Operations, and partner-facing teams across distributed locations.

Who You Are

10+ years of experience across data engineering, cloud platforms, software engineering, or related disciplines, including meaningful technical leadership responsibility.

Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams, ideally in a distributed and multicultural environment.
Broad, hands-on AWS experience and sound understanding of cloud architecture, security, networking, observability, reliability, automation, and cost management.
Deep expertise in relational database architecture and engineering, including MySQL and PostgreSQL, with practical knowledge of schema design, query optimization, indexing, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
Experience designing and executing complex, high-volume data migrations with robust validation, reconciliation, automation, and operational controls.
Experience operating production data platforms and establishing monitoring, incident prevention, recovery, and service-health practices.
Demonstrated ability to partner with application engineering teams and influence application design to improve data quality, performance, and scalability.
Experience defining data-delivery approaches for reporting, analytics, integrations, customers, or external solution partners.
Practical experience applying AI to a real data engineering, data migration, reporting, or operational use case, with the ability to explain the problem, approach, controls, and measurable outcome.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate technical complexity into business outcomes, decisions, and executable plans.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Amazon Aurora MySQL and Amazon RDS in highly available and performance-sensitive production environments.
Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and mixed relational and NoSQL estates.
Hands-on knowledge of ProxySQL or similar database proxy, connection-pooling, and traffic-management technologies.
Experience building cloud-native data platforms, migration factories, reporting ecosystems, or partner-facing data products on AWS.
Experience using infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automation, and modern observability practices in AWS environments.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy, security, compliance, and controlled third-party data access.
Experience in hospitality, SaaS, fintech, retail, or another transaction-intensive and operationally critical domain.
Familiarity with Property Management Systems or the challenges of migrating legacy, customer-specific operational data is a strong plus.
